jobs.title: Software Engineer I, Fullstack (Search)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.Search has become the default way consumers discover where to shop, compare options, and decide what to buy across platforms like Google, TikTok, and even Klarna. As we build a new Ads business and evolve Marketplace into a best in class shopping experience, improving search is one of our highest leverage investments to create an experience users choose and merchants want to invest in.What You'll DoWith the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade-offs related to your work.You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime.You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities.What We Look ForYou have previous work or internship experience working with Javascript/Typescript.You have previous work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale and are experienced using Python or Kotlin.You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.Base Pay Grade - JEquity Grade - 5Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $130,000 - $180,000USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $115,000 - $165,000Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.Benefits Designed For YouOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Full-Stack Engineer — Business Systems (AI-Native)Whitespace Solutions · Jakarta, Indonesia (Hybrid) · Full-timeWHO WE AREWhitespace Solutions is a Jakarta-based consultancy that builds AI-augmented business software. We build it for clients, and we build our own products. We're a small, growing engineering team. You'd work directly with the founder who sets the architecture, alongside a business analyst who models the client's process.Your time splits roughly 50/50 between client delivery and our own products. That means moving between codebases and domains, sometimes within the same week: retail and inventory, ERP-style operations, document automation.THE ROLEWe're hiring early-career engineers (roughly 1–3 years of experience, or fresh graduates who can show the ability). You'll turn business workflows into reliable software and ship features end to end: UI, API, and database.We work agent-native: coding agents investigate, implement, test and review alongside us. That makes plausible code cheap. What stays scarce is judgment: knowing what good software looks like, why it's good, and when the agent is confidently wrong. That's what we hire for. We expect you to learn fast and largely on your own, using agents, docs and code review rather than formal training.The question we care about: can you use AI as leverage without outsourcing your judgment to it?WHAT YOU'LL DO- Build features end to end: screens in React/Next.js, APIs in TypeScript or Python, schemas and migrations in PostgreSQL.- Turn an analyst's process map into data models, state transitions and permissions.- Integrate with clients' existing systems (ERPs, POS, spreadsheets, third-party APIs) rather than replacing them.- Build AI-assisted workflows, such as extracting structured data from documents, with source tracing and human review.- Direct coding agents through investigation, implementation and testing, then review their diffs before anything ships.- Write tests for the dangerous paths: concurrent updates, retries, partial failures.- Debug issues from symptom to root cause instead of patching the surface.- Join client sessions to clarify requirements, run UAT, and explain how the system behaves.- Improve our engineering system: tests, CI gates, docs, agent instructions.WHAT YOU'LL WORK ONRecent and current work includes:- a POS and inventory platform for a multi-store retail chain;- a tender pricing and quote-to-cash engine for an enterprise services company;- AI document extraction that reconciles accounts-receivable records against source documents;- an AI sales role-play and coaching platform, our own SaaS product;- an ERP rollout, including integrations with the client's existing systems.The analyst models the process. You turn it into working software, and you ask the technical questions the requirements missed:- What is the source of truth for product master data, and which systems may only read it?- Two cashiers sell the last unit at the same moment. What happens?- Should this validation live in the UI, the service layer, or a database constraint?- A downstream system is down. Fail, retry, queue, or degrade? And what does the user see?- How do we prove a generated document field came from the right source?A representative task, once you're ramped up: A branch receives stock from a distributor. Compare the delivery against the order, record discrepancies, update trustworthy stock, keep an audit trail, and behave sensibly if part of the process fails. You'd:- identify the entities and state transitions, plus the failure and concurrency cases;- design the schema and API, and the screens a branch user works in;- implement it with agents;- test the dangerous paths;- explain the design.HOW WE WORKThe repository is part of how engineering runs, not just where the code lives. It holds the specs, the architecture decisions and invariants, workplans with acceptance criteria, agent instructions, tests and CI gates. These make intent legible to humans and agents alike, so important rules are enforced mechanically rather than remembered. Improving that system (tests, gates, docs, agent instructions) is part of the job."Done" means evidence: what was tested or observed. "The agent says it works" is not verification. Agents do engineering work. Authority over risky actions stays with people.The founder reviews your designs and the evidence for your changes. That makes you the first line of review on the code itself, including code an agent wrote. Expect your design choices to be questioned; that's how you'll learn.NEEDED AT ENTRY- Solid programming fundamentals in TypeScript and/or Python.- Can build a feature end to end: a React/Next.js interface, the API behind it, and the data underneath.- Working SQL and relational modeling: keys, constraints, joins, indexes.- Reading unfamiliar code, including an agent's diff, and accurately explaining what it actually does.- Explaining why you chose an approach, not just that it works.- A habit of verifying your own assumptions.- Comfort with AI coding tools, or eagerness to work this way.- You learn new tools and domains fast, on your own.- Working English (code and docs are in English) and fluent Bahasa Indonesia for analyst and client conversations.WHAT YOU'LL GROW INTO- Failure-scenario thinking: what breaks, when, and how badly. Think load, concurrency, dependency outages and partial failure.- Turning quality goals (reliability, consistency, security) into concrete scenarios you can test.- Transactions, concurrency, idempotency and safe retries.- Backward-compatible schema migrations.- Putting business rules where they can actually be enforced: the database is part of correctness, and UI validation alone is not enough.- Interfaces that tell the truth about system state: pending, failed, partially applied.- Integration design, queues and background jobs, auditability.- Code taste. That means clear ownership, cohesive modules, explicit contracts, and abstractions that exist for a reason. It also means spotting the warning signs: duplicated rules, multiple writers to one source of truth, catch-all error handling, unsafe migrations.- Directing agents well. Give context, outcome and constraints; have the agent investigate before it implements; read diffs, not summaries.USEFUL, NOT REQUIRED- ERP, POS, inventory or procurement domains- Multi-tenant SaaS- FastAPI, Prisma, PostgreSQL- LLM APIs and RAG- Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment- ETL/ELT basicsPROBABLY NOT A FIT IF YOU- need detailed tickets before you can make progress;- ship AI-generated code you don't understand;- optimize for making the test pass rather than making the system correct;- treat the database as passive storage;- add abstractions or technologies without a concrete reason;- aren't curious about the business behind the code.HOW WE THINK ABOUT EXPERIENCEThe range is flexible. A one-year engineer who reasons clearly can outperform a three-year engineer who has only followed tickets. The answer we like hearing is: "I don't know yet. Here's what I'd inspect, the trade-offs I think matter, and the evidence I'd want before choosing."

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Resource Access Manager Team
jobs.description: DescriptionThe Amazon Web Services (AWS) Identity team builds, operates, and innovates the identity, authentication, and authorization stack for the AWS cloud. Our mission is to push the technical boundaries to enable AWS customers to run their business workloads confidently and securely. As part of this mission, AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) enables customers to securely share their AWS resources across accounts, organizations, and organizational units — simplifying multi-account governance while maintaining fine-grained access controls.AWS RAM allows customers to centrally manage resource sharing at scale, eliminating the need to create duplicate resources in every account. As AWS grows and customers adopt increasingly complex multi-account strategies, RAM must evolve to support new resource types, richer sharing policies, and higher-order scalability demands. We are looking for strong software engineers to build the next generation of resource sharing infrastructure. Individuals interested in this position should have experience building high-performing, reliable systems in a distributed, multi-tenant environment at a fast pace.You'll thrive in this role if you are passionate about building highly available, fault-tolerant distributed systems that operate seamlessly across organizational boundaries. You care deeply about API design that makes complex sharing workflows intuitive — making "the right thing, the easy thing." You think about the customer experience when weighing engineering trade-offs, whether that's designing retention behaviors for departing accounts, enabling resource discovery, or ensuring consistent state across asynchronous workflows. You value operational excellence — advocating for actionable alarms, eliminating toil, and squashing flaky tests before they erode confidence. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Growth Platform - Backend
jobs.description: About WoltAt Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.🚀 Software Engineer, Growth Platform - BackendGrowth Platform is how DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo market as one. We're building a single AI-native marketing platform across all three brands, unifying customer data, intelligence, and execution so every partner team can launch faster, personalize better, learn continuously, and scale wins across brands. The scope is global, the ambition is large, and we're only getting started. We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI.💡 What you’ll be doingAn AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a focused team can ship.Real ownership, real impact. Growth Platform powers marketing across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, reaching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end, from the idea through production, and see your work matter at scale across three brands.Cross-org engineering at the frontier. We work across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to unify customer data, intelligence, and execution into one platform. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition, marketing at scale, and international complexity.Leverage those compounds. Everything we ship is leverage: unify the data, sharpen the intelligence, and streamline execution so every partner marketing team can launch faster, personalize better, and learn continuously. When we get it right, wins scale across all three brands instead of being rebuilt one at a time.We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. This isn't about using Copilot to autocomplete boilerplate. We mean engineers who:Design workflows where AI agents handle entire task loops, from spec to PR.Think in terms of orchestration: what does a human review, what does the agent own?Build internal tooling and abstractions that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable for the whole team.Stay curious and ahead of the curve - trying new models, agents, and tools as they emerge, and forming strong opinions about what's genuinely useful vs. hype.If you find yourself naturally asking "can an agent do this?" before reaching for the keyboard, you'll fit right in.🔍 Our humble expectationsStrong engineering fundamentals - you've built and shipped software that runs at scale, and you understand what that entails: testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability.Genuine enthusiasm for AI-first development. You use AI tools daily and have formed real opinions about how to get the most out of them.Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do.Collaborative instincts - Growth Platform sits at the intersection of backend, data, ML, and product. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception.🙌 About YouYou've built and shipped real software - products, platforms, APIs, apps - and you know what it takes to keep things running reliably in production. You have opinions about architecture but hold them lightly. You write tests. You read the alerts. You don't leave loose ends.What sets you apart right now is that you're genuinely excited about where engineering is going. You've been experimenting with AI agents and agentic coding workflows - not because someone told you to, but because you couldn't help yourself. You think about how to redesign your development loop from first principles, not how to bolt AI onto the way you already work.You communicate well, collaborate easily across disciplines, and care about the product as much as the code. You're the kind of engineer who asks "what's the best way to..." and then actually follows through.🌍 Where You'll WorkThis role is based in our tech hub in Helsinki.Our Commitment to Diversity and InclusionWe’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
